claims: The Phoenix Suns have a 45-37 record.
The Phoenix Suns play the Golden State Warriors in a Play-In Tournament game.
The game is on Friday, April 17, 2026.
The game is at 7:00 p.m. MST.
The game is at 10:00 p.m. ET.
The game is at the Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, AZ.
The game is televised on Amazon Prime Video.
The winner gets the 8th seed to play the Oklahoma City Thunder on April 19.
